# Alaska Team Raises $190,000 for Providence Alaska Children’s Hospital


Sep 25, 2026


Share


A spectacular ride through Alaska became a powerful journey of generosity during the annual All Aboard for Children fundraiser.


Guests traveled 157 scenic miles to Spencer Glacier and back while enjoying an evening of food and hospitality aboard the train. Behind the scenes, the Holland America Princess Alaska/Yukon team devoted hundreds of hours to planning, preparing and serving.


The team’s hard work helped raise $190,000 for Providence Alaska Children’s Hospital, supporting children and families across the state.
